part.text:
Added Handlebars template engine and layout support. Summary:

- **`src/types.ts`** / **`src/parser.ts`**: pages now carry `template`/`layout` from frontmatter (`parser.ts:66-67`).
- **`src/template.ts`**: new `TemplateEngine` class — loads `.hbs` templates from `./templates/`, layouts from `./templates/layouts/` (with `{{{body}}}` placeholder), and partials from `./templates/partials/`. Falls back to the built-in renderer when no templates exist, preserving existing behavior.
- **`src/ssg.ts`**: `build()` accepts `templateDir` (default `./templates`) plus `defaultTemplate`/`defaultLayout`.
- **`src/cli.ts`**: new `--templates` flag.
- **`package.json`**: added `handlebars` dependency.
- **`templates/`**: example `default.hbs`, `post.hbs`, `layouts/default.hbs`, and `partials/header|nav|footer.hbs`. `content/posts/hello-world.md` now demonstrates `template: post`.
- **Tests**: new `__tests__/template.test.ts` (8 tests) plus parser and CLI additions.

Verified end-to-end: `about.html` uses the default template + layout with partials; `posts/hello-world.html` uses the `post` template.
